home.title: Wenjun Zhu | Nanyang Technological University (NTU)
home.description: Wenjun Zhu is an Associate Professor at Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. Research in insurance, finance, climate risk and longevity.

zh.title: 朱文君 | 南洋理工大学南洋商学院
zh.description: 朱文君，南洋理工大学南洋商学院长聘副教授、金融系副主任及保险风险与金融研究中心联席主任。研究保险与金融风险、气候变化、人工智能、死亡率与长寿风险。
